title: Pendulum Lines
author: gk122
rules:
To the best of my knowledge, this puzzle uses an original ruleset. Here is a 6x6 tutorial puzzle for getting familiar with the rules.

Normal sudoku rules apply: place the digits 1–9 once each in every row, column and 3×3 box.

Inequalities: Where two cells are separated by an inequality sign, the digit on the open side of the sign is the larger.

Pendulum lines: Digits on a pendulum line swing back and forth, a little less each time. Read from one of its ends, the digits alternate between rising and falling, and each step (the difference between two neighbouring digits on the line) is strictly smaller than the step before it. For example, 2-8-4-6-5 has steps of 6, 4, 2 and 1. Working out which end the line starts from is part of the puzzle.
